name: lexiclash-standalone
description: Self-contained HTML5 solo word-hunt build for game portals (Poki / CrazyGames / GameDistribution). Zero external requests.

scripts.package: npm run build && npm run validate && python3 scripts/zip-dist.py lexiclash-standalone.zip
scripts.package:poki: VITE_PORTAL=poki npm run build && npm run validate && python3 scripts/zip-dist.py lexiclash-poki.zip
scripts.package:crazygames: VITE_PORTAL=crazygames npm run build && npm run validate && python3 scripts/zip-dist.py lexiclash-crazygames.zip
scripts.package:gd: VITE_PORTAL=gamedistribution npm run build && npm run validate && python3 scripts/zip-dist.py lexiclash-gamedistribution.zip
